questions.stem: A 59-year-old male presents to the emergency department with the symptoms of urinary urgency, hesitancy, and the feeling of bladder fullness. The physician notes an enlarged prostate on digital rectal examination. Following a core needle biopsy, he is diagnosed with prostate cancer. Into which of the following structures do the prostatic ducts open?
